claims.text: The hotel sits atop one of Amman's seven hills, where modern and historic Amman meet.

findings.quote: At the heart of the city, where modern and historic Amman meet, a top one of the city’s most prominent seven hills, Grand Hyatt Amman stands out
findings.note: States the hotel is atop one of the seven hills where modern and historic Amman meet.

claims.text: The hotel is on Hussein Bin Ali Street in Jabal Amman.

findings.quote: Hussein Bin Ali St., Jabal Amman, PO Box 831159, 11183 Amman, Jordan
findings.note: The address confirms Hussein Bin Ali St. in Jabal Amman.

claims.text: The Citadel and the Roman Theatre are close to the hotel.

findings.quote: including the Citadel and Roman Theatre steps away.
findings.note: Describes both attractions as steps away from the hotel.

claims.text: Rooms have a marble bathroom with a separate bathtub and shower.

findings.quote: freshen up in the spacious marble bathroom that comes with a separate bathtub and shower.
findings.note: Room descriptions mention a marble bathroom with separate bathtub and shower.

claims.text: Deluxe rooms with poolside access have an outdoor terrace.

findings.quote: Feel at home in this contemporary 36-square-meter room with an outdoor terrace and poolside access.
findings.note: Deluxe poolside access rooms have an outdoor terrace.

claims.text: Club rooms include access to the Grand Club Lounge on the 9th floor, with all-day refreshments, evening canapes and cocktails.

findings.quote: Guests staying in Club Rooms also enjoy exclusive access to the Grand Club Lounge on the 9th floor, offering all-day refreshments, evening canapés, alcoholic drinks, and cocktails.
findings.note: All elements are covered: the lounge name, the 9th floor, refreshments, canapés and cocktails.

claims.text: The Royal Suite with Terrace offers panoramic views of historic Amman from its terrace.

findings.quote: Offering panoramic views of historic Amman from its spacious terrace
findings.note: From the Royal Suite with Terrace description.

findings.quote: Rebalance your physical and spiritual energy with a transforming body treatment or vigorous workout at Zara Spa on Level 1.
findings.note: Zara Spa offers body treatments.

claims.text: The Zara Fitness Center has floor-to-ceiling windows that let in natural light.

findings.quote: Located on the 1st floor, our exclusive fitness center is open 24 hours a day with floor-to-ceiling windows allowing natural light to flood the space.
findings.note: Appears under the Zara Fitness Center heading.

claims.text: The Grand Hyatt Residences in the adjacent Hyatt Tower offer one- to four-bedroom serviced apartments with full kitchens and private balconies.

findings.quote: Located in the Hyatt Tower adjacent to the hotel, the Grand Hyatt Residences features serviced apartments
findings.note: Confirms the location and the serviced apartments.

findings.quote: These one- to four-bedroom units feature full kitchens and private balconies offering breathtaking views of Amman.
findings.note: Confirms the bedroom range, kitchens and balconies.

claims.text: 32 North restaurant has glass walls looking onto a free-standing kitchen.

findings.quote: Through clever glass walls, diners can enjoy a view of the custom-made, free-standing kitchen
findings.note: From the 32º North description.

claims.text: The Lombard serves Northern Italian cooking with a modern take on traditional recipes.

findings.quote: serving Northern Italian cooking with a modern take on traditional recipes.
findings.note: From The Lombard Amman description.

claims.text: The hotel has a distinctive carved pink stone facade and offers 360-degree views of the city.

findings.quote: Grand Hyatt Amman stands out with its distinctive carved pink stone façade, offering sweeping 360-degree views of the city.
findings.note: Both the façade and the 360-degree views are confirmed.

claims.text: Blue Mosque View rooms overlook the old hills of Amman and the King Abdullah I Mosque with its blue mosaic dome.

findings.quote: overlooking the old hills of Amman and the famous King Abdullah I Mosque which is capped by a magnificent blue mosaic dome.
findings.note: From the Blue Mosque View room description.

claims.text: The Grand Royal Suite with Terrace has hand-picked artworks, a deep soaking bathtub and a terrace overlooking historic Amman.

findings.quote: Enjoy the hand-picked artworks, deep soaking bathtub and the magnificent terrace overlooking historic Amman.
findings.note: From the Grand Royal Suite with Terrace description.

claims.text: The hotel has indoor and outdoor swimming pools, with steam rooms, a sauna and a whirlpool.

findings.quote: Unwind in a serene setting at our indoor and outdoor swimming pools, located on Level 1.
findings.note: Confirms the indoor and outdoor pools.

findings.quote: or rejuvenating in the steam rooms, sauna, and whirlpool
findings.note: Confirms the steam rooms, sauna and whirlpool.

claims.text: The Lounge has two large open fireplaces and a conservatory with floor-to-ceiling windows.

findings.quote: From the novel designer furniture and lighting fixtures to two large open fireplaces, floor-to-ceiling windows in the conservatory and a spectacular view
findings.note: From The Lounge description.

claims.text: Queen Alia International Airport is about a 30-minute drive from the hotel.

findings.quote: 30-minute drive to/from the hotel.
findings.note: Listed under Queen Alia International Airport (AMM), 34 kilometers.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the hotel's large size may feel less intimate.
